milestone: SeLinOS taskd combined reservation state M1

contract.request: The probe can send only the exact two-word RESERVE_BUNDLES request for slot 1.
contract.result: Taskd reports success only after separately validating status-only objectd and memd reservation replies for slot 1.
contract.authority: Taskd receives only one probe endpoint, two downstream endpoints and one success notification; no object, mapping, child TCB, VKA, VSpace, device or other lease capability is transferred.

required_markers: SeLinOS taskd reservation M1: exact combined slot 1 request accepted.
SeLinOS objectd reservation M2: status-only slot 1 reservation returned.
SeLinOS taskd reservation M1: objectd status-only reservation validated.
SeLinOS memd reservation M2: status-only slot 1 reservation returned.
SeLinOS taskd reservation M1: memd status-only reservation validated.
SeLinOS taskd reservation M1: both status-only reservations pending; no task created.
SeLinOS taskd reservation M1 probe: combined status-only reservation passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS taskd reservation M1: malformed combined request rejected.
SeLinOS taskd reservation M1: object reservation rejected.
SeLinOS taskd reservation M1: mapping reservation rejected.

not_claimed: object, capability, TCB, CSpace, VSpace, page-table, frame, stack or mapping lease transfer
dynamic child creation, child configuration, start, resume, teardown, release or reuse
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading or dynamic linker semantics
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
